# Program Overview

The **BYU AI Foundry** is an AI-native product studio and consultancy, and an official program
of the BYU Marriott School of Business. We build AI products. One team works out what is worth
building and then ships it, because those are no longer two jobs.

[**Start a conversation →**](mailto:aifoundry@byu.edu)

## Three Offerings

Engagements usually combine them. Most clients start with one and add the others as the work
proves out.

**Full-stack applications.** Net-new web and mobile applications, built end to end on a modern
stack and shipped to production. Any language the job calls for. Customer-facing products,
products you sell to other businesses, and internal line-of-business tools.

**AI integration and orchestration.** AI wired into the systems you already run, rather than a
standalone prototype that never reaches anyone's daily work. Agents and copilots that work
against your data, automations across Slack, Notion, and your existing stack, and document
processing, extraction, routing, and summarization.

**AI enablement and training.** We set your team up to build this way themselves, using the
same tooling we use on the engagement. Claude Code, Codex, and frontier agent tooling, agentic
workflow and automation setup, and co-working alongside your staff before handoff.

## Three Phases

**Find the problem, build the thing, hand it over.** One fixed fee of **$22,000** covers all
three phases across an 8-month engagement. Run as a sequence rather than a menu.

| | Phase | What happens |
|---|---|---|
| **01** | **Audit and discovery** | An AI-specific audit of your business. We find where AI actually helps you: which products are worth building, which workflows are worth automating. The output points at specific things to build, with an estimate and a sequence. |
| **02** | **Build** | We build and ship working software. Not a report, not a prototype. Production code, integrated with your systems, running in your environment. |
| **03** | **Transfer** | We co-work with your people throughout the build and hand off ownership at the end. The capability stays in-house after we go. |

## What Makes This Different

**We ship, not advise.** A strategy firm rarely leaves a working product behind. Every
engagement ends with software running in your hands. That is the line between us and a
traditional consultancy, and it is deliberate.

**Strategy and engineering in one team.** The people deciding what to build are the people
building it. Nothing is lost in a handoff between a strategy team and a delivery vendor,
because there is no handoff.

**MBB-caliber thinking, AI-accelerated pricing.** Led by an ex-McKinsey faculty advisor,
delivered by a bench of MBAs and undergraduate engineers. The work meets a top-tier consulting
standard at a fraction of top-tier rates.

**We are built on the tooling we sell.** We run on frontier agent tooling internally. When we
set up your team, we are teaching the workflow we use every day, not one we read about.

## Who Is on Your Team

Each engagement is staffed with a mixed team drawn from the MBA bench and the undergraduate
builders. Every team carries three roles:

| Role | Responsibility |
|------|----------------|
| **Client lead** | Your single point of contact. Runs the weekly call, sends the weekly update, owns scope conversations |
| **Builders** | The engineering. Application code, integrations, models, and deployment |
| **QC lead** | Reviews everything before it reaches you. Owns the quality standard |

Product evaluation and QC is a standing function inside the Foundry, not something invented per
project. A faculty advisor oversees every engagement.

## Academic Credit

Students enroll in the AI Foundry, cross-listed as **MBA 693R** and **STRAT 490R**, for 3.0
credit hours per semester and 6.0 across the year. Academic credit is how the bench is staffed;
it does not change what you receive or the terms you receive it under.

## Commercial Terms

**$22,000 per engagement, fixed fee.** A standard engagement runs 8 months and covers all three
phases: audit and discovery, build, and transfer. The fee is fixed at the start. There are no
hourly rates and no change orders for work inside the agreed scope.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Fee** | $22,000, fixed |
| **Duration** | 8 months |
| **Team** | 2 dedicated builders, plus a QC lead and faculty oversight |
| **Guaranteed capacity** | 20 team-hours per week, 640 hours over the engagement |

The team is small on purpose. Two builders working 10 hours each per week, with QC and faculty
oversight riding on top, is enough to ship a focused product and not enough to sprawl. Discovery
exists to make sure what we build fits inside that capacity.

A shorter discovery-only engagement is scoped separately and priced smaller.

**Intellectual property.** You retain full rights to all deliverables, code, models, and
documentation.

**Confidentiality.** Every student signs your NDA, or the Foundry's standard mutual NDA, before
receiving data.

## Timing

We accept projects on a **rolling basis**. There is no application deadline. Phase boundaries
are set per engagement, and a discovery audit can start on a short cycle. The constraint is
bench capacity, so when the bench is full new engagements queue for the next opening.

## What We Do Not Do

- Pure research with no artifact at the end
- Work requiring systems access that cannot be provisioned
- Safety-, clinical-, or compliance-critical determinations
- Staff augmentation on an existing backlog
